# Sela Thorn

Sela Thorn is Ilia Vane's sister, and she is not a member of the party.

She is the duke's third agent. Sela Thorn is the one who stamped the
thistle. She met Ilia once, on the toll road, and Ilia did not recognise
her.

Sela Thorn is in Greymoor. She wants the pouch back before the party
reaches Blackmoor.

Related: [[Ilia Vane]], [[Duke Reynard]]
